name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Brings an element forward as it scrolls into view, tied to the scroll: rise, tilt, scale, blur or slide.
docs: Pure CSS scroll-driven animation: nothing is hidden before hydration, and reduced motion or a browser without scroll timelines shows the element at rest. Give a row of reveals an increasing order to land them in sequence. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.
